data.name: Azeeza
data.gender_notes: Azeeza is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: She who is possessed of grace and beauty. The name Azeeza carries the meaning “Gracious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Azeeza usually hope their child will grow to embody gracious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the qualities of grace, beauty, and strength. It is a name for a girl who is expected to embody these traits in her life.
data.etymology: Azeeza belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gracious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azeeza total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: عزيزة
in_arabic.meaning: عزيزة تعني الشخصية القيّمة والمحترمة والمحبوبة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عزيزة مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ع-ز-ز' الذي يعني القوة والشرف. في اللغة العربية، عزيزة هي الشخصية التي تحظى بالاحترام والتقدير والمودة. ورد اسم عزيزة في القرآن الكريم في سياق الحديث عن النساء المؤمنات، مما يضفي على الاسم قيمة روحية ودينية.

in_urdu.name: عزیزہ
in_urdu.meaning: عزیزہ کا مطلب ہے قابل احترام، پیاری، اور عزت والی
in_urdu.long_meaning: عزیزہ نام عربی جڑ 'ع-ز-ز' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے طاقت اور عزت. اردو میں، عزیزہ ایک ایسی شخصیت کو کہا جاتا ہے جو احترام، تعریف اور محبت کی مستحق ہو. جنوبی ایشیا میں مسلمانوں کے مابین، یہ نام لڑکیوں کے لئے ایک مقبول انتخاب ہے کیونکہ یہ نام دینی اور ثقافتی اہمیت رکھتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: अज़ीज़ा
in_hindi.meaning: अज़ीज़ा का अर्थ है सम्मानित, प्रिय और आदरणीय
in_hindi.long_meaning: अज़ीज़ा नाम अरबी मूल 'ع-ز-ز' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है शक्ति और सम्मान. भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, अज़ीज़ा नाम की लड़कियों को सम्मानित और प्रिय माना जाता है. यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में भी महत्वपूर्ण है, क्योंकि यह नाम कुरआन में वर्णित महिलाओं के गुणों से जुड़ा हुआ है.

in_pashto.name: عزیزه
in_pashto.meaning: عزیزه د احترام، مینې او ارزښت لرونکې
in_pashto.long_meaning: عزیزه نوم د عربی جڑ 'ع-ز-ز' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې ځواک او عزت دي. په پښتو کلتور کې، عزیزه د یوې ارزښتناکه او محترمه نجلۍ په توګه پېژندل کېږي. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ټولنو کې د منلو وړ دی.

in_english.name: Azeeza
in_english.meaning: Azeeza means respected, beloved, and dignified personality
in_english.long_meaning: The name Azeeza originates from the Arabic root 'ع-ز-ز', which signifies strength, honor, and dignity. In Islamic tradition, Azeeza is associated with qualities of esteemed and cherished individuals. The name appears in the context of righteous women in the Quran, adding spiritual significance. Azeeza symbolizes a person of high moral character, respected and loved by others.

data.cultural_impact: The name Azeeza embodies the ideal of beauty, nobility, and grace that is cherished in Islamic culture. It is a name that signifies elegance and refinement, qualities that are praised and sought after in Islamic societies. The name can be given to a girl as a testimony to her birth into a beloved and gracious family.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Azeeza also holds spiritual significance as it represents the inner beauty and grace that the Quran encourages us to cultivate. In the Islamic tradition, outer beauty is only a reflection of inner beauty. The Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) once said, "Allah is beautiful and loves beauty." Thus, striving for spiritual growth and inner beauty is an essential aspect of Muslim identity. The name Azeeza serves as a reminder for Muslims to strive towards inner beauty, which is more valuable and enduring than physical beauty.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Gracious" symbolizes She who is possessed of grace and beauty. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Azeeza serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of gracious.
